page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2g.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs derived from 32 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, offering a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. A key hardware feature is the inclusion of 7679 GB of local SSD storage, alongside a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear contrast between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics, such as stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores, fall into the weak category. However, the server leverages its 64 dedicated vCPUs to achieve average multi-core performance in stress-ng, Geekbench, and PassMark CPU tests. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression is a notable strength, ranking in the top tier. Memory bandwidth and database operations, including Redis SET operations and static web serving throughput, consistently perform within the average range.

Given the massive 7679 GB of bundled local SSD storage and dedicated CPU allocation, this server offers high resource density for storage-heavy workloads without requiring external block storage attachments. The trade-off lies in its older Intel Xeon architecture, which yields lower single-core efficiency compared to modern compute-optimized instances. This profile makes the ecs.i2g.16xlarge highly suitable for large-scale databases, distributed file systems, indexing workloads, and general-purpose applications requiring high local storage capacity and moderate multi-threaded processing.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2g.16xlarge is an x86_64 server featuring 64 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8163 processor, 256.0 GB of RAM, and a substantial 7679 GB of bundled local SSD storage. Operating on a KVM hypervisor, it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps. Performance benchmarks reveal a trade-off: while single-core processing speeds are weak, multi-core capabilities and memory bandwidth remain average, with multi-threaded decompression showing strong results. The high density of local SSD storage combined with dedicated compute resources makes this instance qualitatively cost-effective for storage-intensive deployments. It is well-suited for large databases, data indexing, and general-purpose workloads requiring high-capacity local storage.
